title: services.packages.create
description: Payload of the WASM handler `create_package` (services._insert_package + N × services._insert_package_item, one transaction). `hub_id`, `current_user_id`, `now` and the id batch are provided by the runtime. `discount_value` is the LEGACY polymorphic field (% or major units by type) the handler still derives into the typed columns — accepted for compatibility, not to be used by new callers. Closed contract (services#9).

discount_type.description: Discriminator of the typed discount (migration 004): `percentage` reads `discount_percent`, `fixed` reads `discount_amount_cents`.

discount_percent_bp.description: Percent off when `discount_type = percentage`, as an INTEGER of BASIS POINTS (1050 = 10,50 %; 0..10000). It is not a `number` on purpose: the runtime types a bind from the value, so a `number` reaches the same statement as int8 or float8 depending on the payload, and the cached statement reads the bytes as whichever came first (services#55). Basis points keep the two decimals and have ONE shape on the wire.

discount_amount_cents.description: Amount off in minor units when `discount_type = fixed` (ADR-0007).

fixed_price.description: Closed price of the whole package in minor units, or null (price = sum of lines minus discount).

validity_days.description: Days the voucher stays redeemable after its first use; null = never expires.

max_uses.description: Uses the voucher grants; null = unlimited.

discount_value.description: LEGACY: percent (`percentage`) or major units (`fixed`), derived by the handler when the typed field is absent. Prefer `discount_percent_bp` / `discount_amount_cents`. It stays a `number` because it never reaches a statement: `create_package` converts it to basis points first (services#55).

items.description: Lines of the package. Each names a live service of THIS hub — the handler checks it against the hub's catalogue (`reads`, ADR-0069) and REFUSES the command if a line names something else, instead of letting the insert match no row and lose the line in silence (services#42). Quantity is fixed-point 10⁶ (ADR-0147: 2000000 = 2 sessions). Duplicated service_ids collapse into one line (the `uq_services_packageitem_pkg_svc` index says so). `maxItems` is the host's id batch: 256 ids, one of them the package header.

quantity.description: Sessions of this service the voucher grants, as FIXED-POINT on a scale of 10⁶ (ADR-0147): 1 session = 1000000, 5 sessions = 5000000. Omitted = 1 session. The `minimum` is the whole scale, not 1, on purpose (services#51): a caller that writes the session COUNT (`quantity: 5`) is sending five millionths of a session, and the handler used to raise it to 1 with a `.max()` and answer `ok` — a five-session voucher sold as one. The value is ambiguous, so it is refused here, in the validation layer, instead of being guessed.
